local_visual_review_notes: Viewed both RTX images: wooden front leaf with three upper glass panes, lower vertical boards, paired pull hardware and matching frame; no missing part or visible misalignment.
local_mechanical_review_notes: Attempt 000005 passes static and one isolated RTX 4090 run to the geometry-derived 121.3-degree stop: three exact resets, fixed frame and zero reported penetration. Reviewed 1.3% uniform moving fit and measured centering resolve the pack's early leaf/jamb stop; all leaf, frame, handle and glass (if present) collisions remain. Hinge is inferred; expert qualification is pending.
